value.name: starts car and drives off
value.description: Asha starts the engine and begins backing the car away, deliberately avoiding another look at the legal pad's numbers.
evidence: She turned the key, and the engine came up under her hands; she did not let herself look at the numbers in the margin of the legal pad one more time before she put the car in reverse

value.name: avoids calling Devin
value.description: Asha chooses not to call Devin because she knows the call would force him to agree with her conclusion.
evidence: because she had already seen what they said and what calling Devin tonight would mean was asking him to agree with her about it

value.name: pulls over to call clerk
value.description: Halfway down the access road, Asha stops on the shoulder and calls the courthouse clerk from memory.
evidence: Halfway down the access road, Asha pulled into the shoulder under a thinned row of sycamores and put the car in park before she dialed the courthouse clerk's direct line from memory.

value.name: requests filing timestamp
value.description: Asha speaks in a controlled, professional manner and asks the clerk for the exact electronic intake stamp on the corrected filing.
evidence: She kept her voice low and procedural, gave the docket number twice, and asked for the electronic intake stamp on the Hatcher corrected filing down to the second, the way she would have asked any junior to ask it.

value.name: records clerk's timestamp
value.description: Asha writes down the timestamp the clerk reads back, using an envelope instead of reopening her briefcase.
evidence: The clerk read the number back, and Asha wrote it along the top margin of an envelope she pulled from the door pocket because she did not want to open the briefcase again on the seat beside her.

value.name: realizes timing discrepancy
value.description: Comparing the clerk's timestamp with her memory, Asha realizes the gap is not what she had believed and points to the wrong side of the timeline.
evidence: When she compared that number, in her head, against the minute she had stood up to call the caseworker, the gap was not the gap she had been telling herself it was; it was the other gap, the one on the wrong side.

value.name: ends clerk call
value.description: Asha thanks the clerk and hangs up, remaining in the car with the engine winding down and other calls looming on her phone.
evidence: She thanked the clerk, ended the call, and sat with her hand still on the phone, the engine ticking down, Devin's number two screens away and Whitfield's voicemail no longer the worst thing queued on the device.

value.name: chooses not to call Devin
value.description: Asha puts the phone away without dialing Devin, lingering on the number she wrote down instead.
evidence: Asha slid the phone back into her coat pocket without dialing, her eyes still on the ballpoint number she had written along the top margin of the envelope.
